articles.title: Who is Melissa Anaya? The woman Delonte West married after overcoming his drug addiction
articles.summary: From a 20-year romance to marriage
articles.body:
Melissa Anaya has attracted public attention after former NBA player Delonte West announced that they were getting married, marking a new chapter in a relationship said to span around 20 years.

The news arrived as West approached 11 months of sobriety, making the announcement especially significant for followers who've watched his struggles unfold in public.

On October 15, 2026, West posted a photo of himself and Anaya on Instagram with a message saying they were getting married that day. He later shared a video of the pair driving together, listening to music and showing affection.

The following day, reports said West had confirmed the marriage ahead of a scheduled boxing match against former NBA player Michael Beasley.

Anaya has largely stayed out of the public eye, and reliable details about her age, career, upbringing and family background are scarce. Much of the current interest in her stems from her long-standing connection to West.

While reports describe their relationship as an on-and-off romance lasting about two decades, neither has publicly shared a detailed account of their time together.

West also posted a video of himself picking Anaya up at an airport in Miami. He said it had been 20 years since they'd seen each other in person, although they'd stayed in touch online.

Melissa Anaya and Delonte West's new beginning

West's personal life has drawn attention since his basketball career ended, with public videos and reports documenting periods of instability, arrests and substance-use struggles. Those experiences have often overshadowed his time as a professional athlete.

In March 2026, West announced that he'd reached 100 days sober in a video recorded in Florida. He mentioned working with Wellness Fitness & Performance while celebrating the milestone. Us Weekly reported on the update, which followed earlier reports about his efforts to become sober.

By September, coverage said he'd reached 10 months, putting him close to the 11-month anniversary discussed alongside the wedding news.

West was selected by the Boston Celtics with the 24th pick in the 2004 NBA Draft and later played for the Seattle SuperSonics, Cleveland Cavaliers and Dallas Mavericks. His career lasted eight seasons, but later personal and legal difficulties became a major part of public coverage of his life.

The marriage announcement also came as West prepares to face Beasley in a boxing event promoted by streamer Adin Ross's Brand Risk Promotions.

articles.title: The rumor shaking up the NBA: Anthony Davis for Joel Embiid on LeBron James' 76ers
articles.standfirst: LeBron James reunion rumors grow as 76ers face major questions about Joel Embiid's health
articles.summary: LeBron James reunion rumors grow as 76ers face major questions about Joel Embiid's health
articles.body:
The Philadelphia 76ers have assembled an impressive roster with championship ambitions, but questions surrounding Joel Embiid’s health could complicate their plans.

With LeBron James now part of the picture, speculation is growing that Philadelphia could consider a blockbuster trade involving Anthony Davis if its superstar center struggles to stay healthy.

Philadelphia’s revamped lineup features James, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Embiid , giving the franchise plenty of star power heading into the season.

However, keeping everyone healthy and finding the right balance will be crucial if the 76ers hope to compete for the Eastern Conference title.

Concerns about Embiid’s mobility emerged during preseason discussions, with ESPN analyst Kendrick Perkins questioning how comfortably the center was moving on the court.

Perkins suggested James could be required to spend considerable time at center, potentially changing Philadelphia’s approach to its starting lineup.

"I didn't like the way that Joel Embiid looked last night. I didn't like the way that he was getting up and down the floor...to me, he wasn't moving well, which pointed to me that says LeBron James is gonna play a lot of center position this year,” said Perkins .

“LeBron James is gonna have to and guess what? The Philadelphia 76ers actually could win the Eastern Conference this year, and make it to the NBA Finals with LeBron James playing majority of the center position.”

Could Anthony Davis replace Joel Embiid in Philadelphia?

CBS Sports analyst Sam Quinn believes a potential Embiid-for-Davis trade is worth considering, particularly given James ’ history with his former Los Angeles Lakers teammate.

The two stars won an NBA championship together in 2020, and bringing Davis to Philadelphia would reunite them in pursuit of another title.

Davis would provide defensive versatility, rim protection and experience playing alongside James . His ability to defend multiple positions could also give Philadelphia greater flexibility, especially if Embiid struggles with his movement or availability.

However, such a deal remains hypothetical. Quinn’s assessment hinges on Davis remaining healthy while Embiid experiences continued difficulties.

Davis ’ future has also attracted attention because of questions surrounding a potential contract extension with the Washington Wizards. The Athletic’s Josh Robbins has suggested that Davis ’ influential agent, Rich Paul , will likely continue assessing possible destinations as the February trade deadline approaches.

That doesn’t necessarily mean Philadelphia is negotiating a deal. Any trade would require careful consideration of contracts and the injury histories of both players. Swapping Embiid for Davis wouldn’t eliminate the health risks confronting the franchise.

Meanwhile, Maxey has made clear that Embiid’s availability remains essential to Philadelphia’s success. The guard explained that having the center on the court allows teammates to develop offensive combinations and understand how to play around his unique skill set.

"You can put in more packages," Maxey said. "There's been times where he hasn't been healthy and we get into the game and now we're trying to learn on the (fly)."

Embiid has averaged 49 appearances per season across his career and played only 38 games last season while dealing with multiple health problems. His presence during preseason preparations, however, offers encouragement for a team hoping to build chemistry early.

Philadelphia’s decision could depend on how Embiid performs throughout the campaign. If he remains healthy, the 76ers have compelling reasons to keep their core together. If his availability becomes a recurring concern, Davis could emerge as an intriguing hypothetical target.

articles.title: NBA teams up with major sportsbooks to ban high-risk bets and wagers tied to game-fixing
articles.standfirst: The NBA wants problems with players and gambling under control, as seen with Terry Rozier and Jontez Porter
articles.summary: The NBA wants problems with players and gambling under control, as seen with Terry Rozier and Jontez Porter
articles.body:
The relationship between elite professional sports and the sports betting industry has reached a delicate turning point in recent years.

Today, major sportsbooks sponsor almost every top-tier league across the globe, while hyper-visible global icons like LeBron Jame s and Giannis Antetokounmpo actively promote major gaming brands through high-profile endorsement campaigns.

However, that commercial integration has increasingly clashed with competitive integrity, highlighted by high-stakes gambling controversies that rocked the basketball world, including the lifetime ban of former Toronto Raptors forward Jontay Porter , as well as federal legal scrutiny surrounding notable figures such as Terry Rozier and Chauncey Billups .

These recurring scandals exposed how easily vulnerable wagers, specifically individual player props and micro-bets, could be manipulated by bad actors seeking guaranteed payouts.

New Partnership Between the NBA and Sportsbooks

In a decisive effort to protect the sport, the NBA and prominent sportsbook partners have officially agreed to ban multiple types of exploitable bets ahead of the 2026–27 campaign .

The comprehensive policy overhaul targets micro-markets and vulnerable wagers, such as specific "under" prop parlays , bets on players projected for limited floor time ( fewer than 12 minutes) , and "first-of" micro-bets like who wins the opening tip or scores the game's first basket.

By eliminating these highly manipulative options, the league aims to proactively prevent match-fixing and spot-fixing before bad actors can exploit inside information.

Industry insiders widely anticipate that other major professional leagues, including the NFL, MLB, and European soccer organizations, will quickly adopt similar restrictive measures across their own betting partners to maintain public trust.

This landmark agreement serves as a vital safeguard for the league's credibility, and its timing could not be more ideal. With the regular season officially tipping off next Tuesday, October 20, fans can focus entirely on the action on the floor rather than off-court integrity concerns.

By establishing clear boundaries for sports gambling right now, the NBA enters a thrilling new season with its competitive foundation firmly secured.

articles.title: Boston Celtics player commits egregious five-step travel that goes uncalled by NBA refs
articles.standfirst: Hugo Gonzalez is the latest NBA player to take advantage of the lax rules regarding traveling in modern basketball.
articles.summary: Hugo Gonzalez is the latest NBA player to take advantage of the lax rules regarding traveling in modern basketball.
articles.body:
Basketball fans aren't exactly fond of how referees officiate NBA games. In general, many fans feel that referees call too many ticky-tack fouls, rewarding players who embellish contact in order to get to the free throw line.

But over the past few years, fans have turned their attention to another matter: Players are getting away with taking way too many steps on certain plays . There have been countless instances of blatant travels going uncalled, for whatever reason. The NBA never communicated any new rules for traveling violations, yet refs seemingly don't care if players take an extra step.

Hugo Gonzalez gets away with an utterly blatant travel during Celtics-76ers game

Boston Celtics guard Hugo Gonzalez tested the limits in an unprecedented way on Friday night, though. During the Celtics' game against the Philadelphia 76ers , Gonzalez looked to take a whopping five steps on his way to a fastbreak layup. A travel wasn't called, and the basket counted.

Fans were in utter shock, and the video of the uncalled travel went viral on social media. Some fans tried to argue that Gonzalez was in the process of gathering the ball before the alleged violation . But even if the gather steps aren't counted, he still took at least three or four steps without dribbling once he got possession of the ball .

" Letting them play " is one thing, but letting players get away with clearly breaking the rules shouldn't be a thing in an elite league like the NBA. Players will keep taking advantage of it until refs start being more strict, though.

articles.title: From $165 million NBA career to public service: Amar’e Stoudemire's next chapter
articles.standfirst: He built his reputation as one of the NBA’s most explosive big men, combining strength, speed and leaping ability
articles.summary: He built his reputation as one of the NBA’s most explosive big men, combining strength, speed and leaping ability
articles.body:
A mar’e Stoudemire spent 14 seasons overpowering NBA defenses . Now, the former All-Star is preparing for a very different challenge: protecting and serving his community. The retired basketball star, 43, has graduated from the Miami-Dade Police Academy in Florida, completing the School of Justice’s Basic Law Enforcement Academy with the latest class of cadets. His achievement marks a surprising new chapter for a former NBA superstar who earned more than $165 million during his professional basketball career.

But for Stoudemire , becoming a police officer is not simply a post-retirement experiment. According to the college, it is the fulfillment of a childhood dream inspired by family members who worked in law enforcement.

“For Amar’e, this is more than a second career. Becoming a police officer was a childhood dream, inspired in part by family members who served in law enforcement,” the college said. Stoudemire also received the Harry “Coach” Everett Award , recognizing his contributions to the success of the academy program throughout his training.

From NBA superstar to police academy graduate

Stoudemire built his reputation as one of the NBA’s most explosive big men, combining strength, speed and leaping ability to become a dominant offensive force. He entered the league in 2002 after being selected ninth overall by the Phoenix Suns . He went on to play for the Suns, New York Knicks, Dallas Mavericks and Miami Heat during a 14-year NBA career that included six All-Star selections and the 2002-03 NBA Rookie of the Year award.

His years in Phoenix were particularly memorable. Alongside Steve Nash, Stoudemire became a central figure in the Suns’ fast-paced offense, helping the team emerge as one of the league’s most entertaining contenders during the 2000s.

Stoudemire later became a major signing for the Knicks, bringing his scoring ability to New York before injuries affected the later stages of his NBA career. Given his financial success and accomplishments on the court, a move into law enforcement might seem unexpected . Stoudemire, however, told Sports Illustrated that the decision is about serving a purpose beyond basketball.

Family influences helped shape his decision

Stoudemire explained that his interest in police work developed long before his NBA career made him a household name. “My JV coach was in law enforcement. My uncle, who’s my favorite uncle, was, I mentioned before, also [in] law enforcement, and these are all positive influences that steer me in the right direction,” he told Sports Illustrated.

Those relationships helped make policing a meaningful goal rather than an arbitrary career change after basketball. His graduation from the academy also signals that he has undertaken formal training for the profession. The Harry “Coach” Everett Award provides another distinction, recognizing his contributions during the program.

Stoudemire's athletic background may have helped him approach the physical demands and discipline of academy training, but police work presents challenges far removed from competing in the NBA . The role requires judgment, communication, sound decision-making and a commitment to public service.

For the former basketball star, the transition means applying the discipline developed over years of professional competition to a different kind of responsibility. Although his playing career ended, Stoudemire has hardly disappeared from the basketball world.

He continued playing overseas after his NBA years and enjoyed success in Israel, winning championships in the Israeli Basketball Premier League. He also worked as a player development coach with the Brooklyn Nets, helping younger players refine their skills and adjust to the professional game.

articles.title: The brutal personal attack against Savannah James that has sparked outrage: “She's beautiful but she has no talent”
articles.standfirst: Savannah has been told she is not capable of reading the room
articles.summary: Savannah has been told she is not capable of reading the room
articles.body:
T asha K has launched a personal attack on Savannah James , questioning her abilities and criticizing her growing presence in entertainment as the online personality's remarks targeted LeBron 's wife - extending beyond her professional venture and into to her personal life and marriage.

The comments add to Tasha K 's history of provocative celebrity commentary, which has attracted a substantial online audience while also generating controversy as the media personality has repeatedly targeted high-profile figures, making outspoken judgments about their careers, relationships and public images.

“Savannah James has no talent to start, can't read the room,” Tasha K said on her UnWine podcast. “She's a gorgeous woman, but don't get me wrong, we are not gonna sit here, 'there is a talent.'

“That's why she is doing a podcast and can't read the room because she is disassociated from the real world, she is disassociated from her own friends.”

Tasha K also made remarks about LeBron 's alleged preferences in relationships, by suggesting the four-time NBA champion prefers white women, widening her criticism beyond Savannah 's professional work.

Tasha K , whose real name is Latasha Kebe , has built her audience through celebrity gossip, interviews and outspoken online commentary but her career and her controversial remarks have also faced legal controversy, including a defamation lawsuit in favor of Cardi B over false claims.

Tasha K renews criticism of Savannah's podcast and personal life

This is not the first time Tasha K has publicly criticized Savannah as the pundit previously targeted her after the 40-year-old and her best friend, April McDaniel , discussed an August incident involving an employee at a Hermes store in Milan , Italy .

Tasha K questioned the reported outcome for the employee and made further remarks about Savannah 's identity and public profile. Her latest comments continue a pattern of confrontational commentary directed at the James family.

"So the story is LeBron James' wife, because that's all she does,” Tasha K scolded. “She's just his wife, she wears blonde hair, cosplays as a Kardashian. I guess she is going around, she is shopping, and they are supposed to know who she is...

“They fired her and just hired a new [expletive] and told them, 'Listen, you don't ever tell them we don't accept black money. We don't do that.' You just gotta profile wisely."

Savannah has not addressed Tasha K ’s comments, but she has spoken about the importance of spending time with her husband despite their different interests as she explained that watching basketball alongside LeBron helps them maintain their connection, even when she would rather be doing something else.

“My love language is quality time,” Savannah said. “So if this is where I got to fit it in, then I guess. I'd just be on my phone the whole time, but I'm here with you. We're in the same space.”

The couple have known each other since LeBron was in high school and have built a family together, including their son Bronny , who has followed his father into the NBA with the Los Angeles Lakers , although the former now plays for the Philadelphia 76ers .

articles.title: Nikola Jokić’s behind-the-back half-court dime sends another warning to the NBA
articles.summary: Nikola Jokić does not need to jump over defenders, race past them or even look directly at his target to make a basketball possession unforgettable. Sometimes, all he needs is a glimpse of open space and a basketball in his hands. The Denver Nuggets center delivered another reminder of his extraordinary court vision against the Los Angeles Lakers, firing a behind-the-back pass from around half-court in transition to rookie forward Trevon Brazile. The audacious dime turned a fast break into a highlight-reel moment and gave NBA fans another reason to pay attention to Jokić as the new season approaches. The pass was spectacular not simply because of its style, but because of what it revealed about the way Jokić sees the floor.

articles.title: The ultimate disrespect: Some say LeBron James ‘has become Bronny’ after a brutal blunder
articles.standfirst: LeBron James roasted by fans after two shocking blunders spark questions about his declining explosiveness
articles.summary: LeBron James roasted by fans after two shocking blunders spark questions about his declining explosiveness
articles.body:
LeBron James has become a target of social media criticism after two uncharacteristic mistakes near the basket during the Philadelphia 76ers’ preseason clash with the Boston Celtics on Friday.

The veteran’s brief struggles quickly attracted attention online, with some fans questioning whether Father Time is beginning to catch up with the four-time NBA champion.

The first incident occurred midway through the second quarter when James collected a defensive rebound and charged toward the opposite basket. With plenty of space ahead of him, the 41-year-old appeared to have a straightforward opportunity to score.

However, he lost control of the ball while gathering himself for a layup, resulting in an unexpected turnover.

Things got worse just two possessions later. James failed to handle a pass from Tyrese Maxey underneath the basket, giving the ball away again in a sequence that left fans questioning what they had witnessed.

The back-to-back errors sparked a wave of reactions across social media. Some users suggested James ’ trademark explosiveness had diminished, while others used the opportunity to compare him unfavorably with his son, Bronny James.

“Without his explosiveness Bron has become bronny,” wrote one fan.

“LeBron James looks like he’s 51, not 41! This is going to be a disaster!,” wrote another.

LeBron James’ numbers offer some perspective after costly mistakes

Despite the frustrating moments, James ’ overall performance was more respectable than the online backlash might suggest. Philadelphia eventually lost 125-120 to Boston in overtime, but James contributed eight points, eight rebounds and seven assists in 24 minutes and 42 seconds of action.

His numbers demonstrated that he could still contribute through playmaking and rebounding, even when his finishing around the rim wasn't particularly impressive. While the two turnovers provided ammunition for his critics, isolated mistakes don't necessarily indicate a broader decline in ability.

The discussion comes as James prepares for another NBA season at 41, an age when sustaining the physical demands of professional basketball presents considerable challenges.

His career has been defined by remarkable longevity, making even relatively minor errors a talking point among supporters and detractors alike.

According to reports, he has access to Fanatics aviation services through an endorsement arrangement, allowing him to reduce a journey that can take approximately two hours by road to around 40 minutes.

When asked about traveling to work by helicopter, James played down the unusual arrangement, explaining that he'd done it before and viewed it as simply another transportation option.

“I’ve done it before,” James said on Friday. “Just another way of transportation, that’s all.”

Philadelphia is scheduled to open its regular season against the New York Knicks on Tuesday. Given competitive games are right around the corner, James will have an opportunity to shift the conversation back toward his basketball performance.

articles.title: Steve Kerr freezes as his look-alike walks courtside in a bizarre multiverse moment at a Warriors game
articles.standfirst: Kerr seemed to need a moment to process what he was seeing
articles.summary: Kerr seemed to need a moment to process what he was seeing
articles.body:
F or a few seconds, Chase Center seemed to slip into a multiverse, with two Steve Kerrs in the building at once. One was where he belonged: near the Golden State Warriors’ bench. The other was walking along courtside with a half-finished beer in his hand, dressed in gray and looking so much like the “real” coach that the whole scene felt like a glitch in the arena’s reality.

The fan walked past the rows just behind the Warriors’ bench, sporting the same silver hair and signature haircut . He kept a serious expression as people turned to watch him go by. From behind, even his build and the way he walked made the illusion seem almost real.

Then Kerr spotted him. The coach stood up and looked over, holding his gaze for a moment, as if his brain needed time to catch up with what his eyes were seeing . It was a subtle reaction, but that pause made the moment special: Kerr wasn’t watching a replay or a video board. His double was right there, moving through the crowd with a beer.

The man behind Steve Kerr’s uncanny look-alike

The look-alike is Steve Gillis, a teacher and volleyball coach from Las Vegas. People have mistaken him for Kerr for years; he first went viral at a Warriors game in 2024. Gillis has said the resemblance is purely coincidental: even the gray hair and similar haircut weren’t a deliberate attempt to imitate the coach.

Gillis isn’t a stranger who happened to look like Kerr for one night . He’s the same fan who has fooled other spectators before and this time, the coach himself got to see the resemblance up close.

Steve Gillis was dressed casually in gray, carrying a beer and walking with the calm, serious expression fans associate with Kerr on the sideline. As he made his way to his seat, the scene inevitably brought to mind the famous Spider-Man meme in which two Spider-Men point at each other . All that was missing was for the two “Steves” to turn toward one another and point.

The encounter happened Friday during the Warriors’ final preseason game, a 128-118 win over the Portland Trail Blazers at Chase Center. Golden State finished its exhibition schedule with a 4-2 record, but this uncanny look-alike moment may have been the most surreal scene of the night.

For a moment, it seemed as if the arena had opened a door to another universe, one where Steve Gillis had the seats behind the bench and the real Steve Kerr had to stop and wonder who was who.

articles.title: The Lakers close out the preseason with more shadows than lights
articles.standfirst: Heavy 106-126 blow against Jokic's Nuggets (17+6+8) and doubts about the Doncic era (15+4+2) keep growing
articles.summary: Heavy 106-126 blow against Jokic's Nuggets (17+6+8) and doubts about the Doncic era (15+4+2) keep growing
articles.body:
Los Angeles Lakers closed the preseason with a loss to the Denver Nuggets (106-121) that left more doubts than certainties. JJ Redick's team finished with two wins and three losses and showed that it still needs to adjust many pieces. Without LeBron James , the challenge is to build a competitive project around Luka Doncic , but the early signs invite caution.

The start of the game was especially worrying. Denver dominated 36-22 in the first quarter and even enjoyed a 17-point lead , taking advantage of the mistakes and defensive fragility of the Angelenos. The Lakers finished shooting 42.7% from the field and committed 14 turnovers . The later reaction was not enough to hide their problems against an intense defense.

Too many shadows over the Los Angeles team

Another concern lies in rim protection and the ability to compete physically. The Nuggets found far too many easy chances near the basket - Nikola Jokic finished with 17 points, 6 rebounds and 8 assists - and exploited the Lakers' difficulties in closing down space and controlling the boards. Walker Kessler, expected to provide an interior presence, finished with six points and six rebounds. If they do not improve defensively, they will struggle against the most powerful opponents in the West.

LeBron's departure also forces Doncic to take on even greater responsibility. The Slovenian finished with 15 points, four rebounds, and two assists in 18 minutes , although he committed five turnovers. Austin Reaves contributed 19 points , but the connection between the two of them and the new center still needs more time to develop.

' JJ Redick also does not have his rotation completely defined. The coach is still searching for the most balanced combination to support Doncic and Reaves , while injuries and preseason experiments make continuity difficult. "I’m looking for balance in the lineups and players who complement each other and fit together" , Redick explained, according to the Los Angeles Times. The lack of clarity in the roles and the need for more alternatives to organize the offense are still pending issues.'

I’m looking for balance in the lineups and players who complement each other and fit together

There were a few flashes, with interesting contributions from Quentin Grimes, Sandro Mamukelashvili, and Ziaire Williams, but not enough to change the overall picture. The Lakers need to cut down on turnovers, raise their defensive intensity, and find a collective identity that goes beyond Doncic's talent.

Preseason does not deliver a verdict, but the Los Angeles team enters the official start with more questions than certainties and the feeling that the transition after LeBron's departure will be more complicated than expected.

articles.title: LeBron James and the Sixers set an NBA record as Knicks matchup at MSG becomes the most expensive home opener ever
articles.standfirst: The Knicks vs. the Sixers is the most expensive opener in NBA history
articles.summary: The Knicks vs. the Sixers is the most expensive opener in NBA history
articles.body:
We are just a couple of days away from the start of the 2026-27 NBA season , and opening day on October 20th promises unprecedented excitement across the league.

Action tips off earlier than usual ahead of the traditional evening slate, starting at 3:00 PM EST with Jayson Tatum and the Boston Celtics visiting last season's Eastern Conference top seed, the Detroit Pistons .

Later in the evening, the defending champion New York Knicks will raise their long-awaited championship banner and receive their hardware inside Madison Square Garden against a newly star-studded Philadelphia 76ers roster powered by LeBron James and Jaylen Brown .

The opening-night festivities will then wrap up in the West with a thrilling Western Conference Finals rematch between the Oklahoma City Thunder and the San Antonio Spurs .

Knicks Season Opener Shatters NBA Home Opener Records

When the official regular-season schedule dropped a few months ago, revealing that the reigning champion Knicks would open against LeBron James and his new-look 76ers , secondary ticket marketplace prices exploded, with peak listings climbing up toward $2,500 .

Now, with just days remaining before all 30 franchises host their respective home openers, ticket distribution platform TickPick highlights a staggering financial disparity between the league's marquee markets and the rest of the NBA .

The opening night clash at Madison Square Garden remains by far the most expensive ticket in the league at a $1,112 get-in price, establishing the highest opening-night price tag in NBA history , a milestone that arguably only major media hubs like New York or California could generate.

By comparison, the second-most expensive home opener on the docket is the TD Garden matchup between the Celtics and Knicks on Friday, October 23 , sitting at $160 , a cost over seven times cheaper than the banner-raising event in Manhattan.

The top three is rounded out by Philadelphia's home opener against the Cleveland Cavaliers at $145 , placing Atlantic Division franchises in full control of the podium and demonstrating how the Eastern Conference now holds the hottest tickets in the sport, led by the clear conference frontrunners.

Western Conference Standouts and the League's Most Affordable Home Openers

Behind the Eastern Conference trio, two Western Conference powerhouses claim the remaining spots in the top five: the San Antonio Spurs ($124) and the Los Angeles Lakers ($110) , rounding out the only franchises across the league featuring home-opener entry prices exceeding the $100 mark.

In stark contrast to these premium pricing tiers, watching live opening-night action in several other markets remains remarkably budget-friendly.

Ticket prices to attend home openers for the Los Angeles Clippers ($19) , Utah Jazz ($19) , New Orleans Pelicans ($12) , Charlotte Hornets ($8) , and Memphis Grizzlies ($7) represent the only entries under $20, offering the most affordable access points in professional basketball.

With the preseason concluding and opening night finally here, high-stakes NBA basketball is officially back.

articles.title: The Sixers sign Tacko Fall to a two-way contract ahead of the regular-season opener
articles.standfirst: Philadelphia bolsters its center depth ahead of opening night following Ariel Hukporti’s season-ending Achilles injury
articles.summary: Philadelphia bolsters its center depth ahead of opening night following Ariel Hukporti’s season-ending Achilles injury
articles.body:
The Philadelphia 76ers have added a towering option to their frontcourt, converting Tacko Fall’s training-camp agreement into a two-way contract just days before the regular-season opener.

The move gives the team another center option as injuries complicate its plans behind Joel Embiid.

ESPN reporter Shams Charania reported the signing Saturday, with Philadelphia later confirming the transaction. Fall stands 7-foot-6 and joined the Sixers on an Exhibit 10 deal in September.

However, a hip strain suffered during training camp kept him out of the preseason, making his availability for the start of the season a key question.

The signing follows a major setback for Ariel Hukporti , who ruptured his right Achilles tendon during Philadelphia’s preseason opener against the New York Knicks. He underwent surgery and is expected to miss the entire season.

Adem Bona has also been dealing with a foot injury, leaving the Sixers short on traditional center depth as they prepare to face New York on Tuesday.

Fall’s contract provides insurance. Two-way players can split time between an NBA team and its G League affiliate, giving Philadelphia flexibility while it evaluates its options. Fall will first need to recover from his hip injury and regain his basketball conditioning after missing the preseason.

Fall offers size and NBA experience

Fall played college basketball at the University of Central Florida from 2015 to 2019 before entering the NBA Draft. He went undrafted in 2019 but signed with the Boston Celtics, spending two seasons with the franchise before joining the Cleveland Cavaliers for the 2021-22 campaign.

He hasn’t appeared in an NBA regular-season game since then, later continuing his career overseas.

Most recently, Fall played for the Ningbo Rockets in China, appearing in 40 games last season and averaging 10.8 points, 6.0 rebounds and 2.2 blocks. That experience could help him stay game-ready, although adjusting to the NBA again will take time.

Across 37 NBA appearances, Fall has averaged 2.2 points and 2.1 rebounds in limited minutes while shooting 67.3% from the field.

During the 2020-21 season with Boston, he averaged 2.5 points and 1.1 blocks per game. Those numbers reflect a limited role, but his size could help protect the rim and provide a target near the basket if he’s ready to contribute.

Philadelphia’s preseason has also highlighted how much work remains for the roster to find its rhythm. In the finale against Boston, Embiid delivered 27 points, eight rebounds and five assists, though the Sixers lost 125-120.

The team’s stars have said they’re still learning to play together, and Embiid has rejected the idea that anyone must sacrifice their strengths for the group to succeed.

With opening night approaching, Fall gives Philadelphia another potential solution to a pressing roster problem. His impact will depend on his recovery and readiness, but the Sixers are clearly seeking more size and depth at a position suddenly under pressure.

articles.title: JJ Redick hints at final roster cut ahead of Lakers’ season opener vs. Warriors
articles.standfirst: Redick explains why the Lakers’ changing roster needs have put Knecht in a difficult position ahead of the regular season
articles.summary: Redick explains why the Lakers’ changing roster needs have put Knecht in a difficult position ahead of the regular season
articles.body:
Los Angeles Lakers head coach JJ Redick has provided a significant hint about Dalton Knecht’s uncertain future, raising questions about the young wing’s chances of surviving the team’s final roster cuts ahead of the season opener against the Golden State Warriors.

The Lakers must trim their roster from 16 players to the NBA’s 15-player limit before the regular season begins. With the deadline approaching, Los Angeles could trade a player to create space, but waiving someone remains another possibility.

Knecht has increasingly emerged as a potential departure as the organization evaluates its options.

Redick addressed Knecht’s situation, acknowledging that the former first-round pick has improved during his first two seasons. However, the coach also explained that changes to the roster have affected the forward’s position within the team.

“I think the biggest thing is the team changed,” Redick said. “The team changed. Needs changed, the fit changed. I think he’s gotten better as a player the last two years.”

Redick added that injuries gave players opportunities last season, but the arrival of additional wings has made things more difficult for Knecht .

The comments didn't confirm his departure, although they highlighted the challenge he faces as the Lakers prepare for another campaign.

Roster changes put Dalton Knecht’s Lakers future in doubt

Los Angeles has considerably more competition on the wing heading into the new season. Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr and Jake LaRavia are among the players competing for opportunities.

Jarred Vanderbilt could also become part of the roster conversation, particularly given the trade speculation surrounding him.

With several alternatives available, Knecht may struggle to secure meaningful minutes. His shooting ability initially made him an intriguing addition to the Lakers, but the team's changing needs appear to have complicated his path toward a regular role.

Knecht’s situation is particularly notable because he nearly left Los Angeles earlier. In February 2025, the Lakers agreed to trade him to the Charlotte Hornets in a deal involving center Mark Williams . articles.standfirst: Stephen Curry backs his WNBA Finals favorite
articles.summary: Stephen Curry backs his WNBA Finals favorite
articles.body:
Stephen Curry made his WNBA Finals lean hard to miss during Friday’s Warriors warmups. Ahead of Golden State’s preseason finale against Portland, he wore a No. 22 Veronica Burton Valkyries jersey with a fresh pair of Curry x Way of Wade 12 PEs. The look put his support for the Bay Area team and his new footwear collaboration on display at once.

The jersey choice made the moment personal for Burton’s family. Her father, Boston sports broadcaster Steve Burton, called it “surreal” to see his favorite NBA player wearing his daughter’s jersey. There’s no reported personal connection between Curry and Burton; the gesture came across as a public salute to the Valkyries and one of their standout players.

Curry’s support for the team predates this Finals run. He attended Valkyries games during their inaugural 2025 season and praised the excitement around the franchise in the Bay Area. “It’s what basketball needs,” he said in a courtside interview.

There’s a natural connection between the teams: the Valkyries and Warriors share an ownership group and play at Chase Center. The Valkyries joined the WNBA as an expansion team in 2025, and Curry’s appearances have helped underline the bond between the two Golden State franchises.

Now, in just their second season, the Valkyries are playing the Atlanta Dream for the WNBA championship. Curry didn’t announce an actual wager, but his choice of jersey made his Finals favorite clear and his fresh Curry x Way of Wade 12s gave the pregame moment an extra bit of style.

articles.title: NBA Season 2026 Key dates: Opening Night, NBA Cup and every date that you must add to your calendar
articles.standfirst: The 2026-27 NBA season tips off on October 20, with a packed calendar featuring the Emirates NBA Cup, Christmas Day showdowns, international games, All-Star Weekend and the race toward the playoffs
articles.summary: The 2026-27 NBA season tips off on October 20, with a packed calendar featuring the Emirates NBA Cup, Christmas Day showdowns, international games, All-Star Weekend and the race toward the playoffs
articles.body:
Basketball fans will soon have plenty of reasons to clear their calendars as the 2026-27 NBA season gets underway.

From the first games in October to the postseason battles in the spring, the league has confirmed a schedule filled with major matchups, holiday showcases and important milestones.

The regular season begins on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, with three games scheduled for Opening Night. The Boston Celtics visit the Detroit Pistons at 3 p.m. ET, followed by the Philadelphia 76ers facing the New York Knicks at 7 p.m. ET.

The Oklahoma City Thunder then take on the San Antonio Spurs at 9:30 p.m. ET. All three games will be shown on NBC and Peacock.

The opening night will offer an early look at several teams hoping to make a statement in the new campaign.

The Knicks will also have the opportunity to celebrate their championship success as they begin another season, while Philadelphia's matchup will feature LeBron James ' new chapter with the 76ers in the spotlight.

However, Opening Night is only the beginning. The schedule includes the NBA's in-season tournament, a five-game Christmas Day slate, international matchups and the traditional late-season push for playoff positioning.

The NBA Cup, Christmas Day and the season's biggest dates

One of the first major events after the regular season begins is the Emirates NBA Cup. Group Play starts on Friday, October 30, with games scheduled on Fridays through November 27, alongside additional matchups on November 24 and 25.

The competition gives teams another trophy to pursue while adding significance to early-season games.

The knockout stage begins with the quarterfinals on December 4 and 5. The semifinals are scheduled for December 8 and/or 9, before the championship game takes place on Friday, December 11, at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.

The NBA Cup's remaining schedule also affects the regular-season calendar, with two games for each team to be assigned according to the results of Group Play.

Christmas Day remains another major fixture on the NBA calendar. Five games will be played on December 25, continuing the league's tradition of showcasing some of its biggest stars and rivalries during the holiday period.

The San Antonio Spurs face the New York Knicks at noon ET in a rematch of the 2026 NBA Finals. The Miami Heat then visit the Boston Celtics at 2:30 p.m. ET, followed by the 76ers against the Los Angeles Lakers at 5 p.m. ET.

The Oklahoma City Thunder travel to Minnesota to face the Timberwolves at 8 p.m. ET, while the Denver Nuggets meet the Golden State Warriors at 10:30 p.m. ET. All five games will air on ABC and ESPN.

The 76ers-Lakers matchup will be particularly notable as James returns to Los Angeles following his move to Philadelphia. Meanwhile, the Knicks-Spurs game offers an early Christmas reminder of the previous season's championship contest.

International games bring the NBA to Europe

The NBA's international schedule also includes two games in Europe. On January 14, 2027, the Spurs face the New Orleans Pelicans at Accor Arena in Paris.

The same teams meet again on January 17 at Co-op Live in Manchester, England. Both games will be available on Prime Video.

The European fixtures give fans outside North America an opportunity to watch NBA action in person while providing the league with another chance to grow its international audience.

Every key date for the 2026-27 NBA season

Here are the most important dates to keep in mind as the campaign progresses:

- October 19, 2026: Rosters must be set for Opening Day by 5 p.m. ET.

- October 20, 2026: NBA regular season begins with a three-game Opening Night.

- October 30, 2026: Emirates NBA Cup Group Play begins.

- November 7, 2026: Denver Nuggets face the Indiana Pacers in the NBA Mexico City Game.

- November 27, 2026: NBA Cup Group Play concludes.

- December 4-5, 2026: NBA Cup quarterfinals.

- December 8-9, 2026: NBA Cup semifinals, with the exact date dependent on the schedule.

- December 11, 2026: NBA Cup championship in Indianapolis.

- December 25, 2026: Five-game Christmas Day showcase.

- January 14, 2027: NBA Paris Game, Spurs vs. Pelicans.

- January 17, 2027: NBA Manchester Game, Spurs vs. Pelicans.

- January 18, 2027: Martin Luther King Jr. Day games.

- January 26-30, 2027: NBA Rivals Week.

- February 11, 2027: NBA trade deadline.

- February 15, 2027: Presidents' Day NBA quadrupleheader.

- February 19-21, 2027: NBA All-Star Weekend in Phoenix.

- April 11, 2027: Final day of the regular season, with all 30 teams in action.

- April 13-16, 2027: SoFi NBA Play-In Tournament.

- April 17, 2027: NBA Playoffs begin.

The trade deadline on February 11 could prove particularly important for teams looking to strengthen their rosters before the postseason. All-Star Weekend, meanwhile, will bring the league's leading players together in Phoenix from February 19 to 21.

The regular-season finale on April 11 will be followed quickly by the Play-In Tournament, scheduled for April 13-16. Teams fighting for the final postseason places will have little time to recover before the pressure intensifies.

The playoffs begin on April 17, marking the start of the road toward the 2027 NBA Finals, which are expected to take place in June.

With major dates spread across almost seven months, the 2026-27 season promises a busy schedule for supporters.

Opening Night marks the return of competitive basketball, but the NBA Cup, international games, holiday matchups and playoff race will each provide their own defining moments.

articles.title: The dream of an NBA franchise in Mexico City could be real
articles.standfirst: In the United States, they are talking about the possibility that the new expansion of their League would come to Mexico
articles.summary: In the United States, they are talking about the possibility that the new expansion of their League would come to Mexico
articles.body:
Mexico City could be on the verge of welcoming one of the greatest sporting milestones in its history if the strong rumor that emerged in the United States comes to fruition: CDMX is being evaluated to host an NBA expansion franchise for the 2028-2029 season.

The news came to light after ESPN revealed that a group of investors based in the Mexican capital approached PJT Partners, the financial firm advising the NBA in its expansion process. The proposal presented includes not only the creation of a new franchise, but also the development of a sports district that would house a modern arena in downtown Mexico City.

That project has the initial approval of PJT Partners, which demonstrates the enormous interest in having Mexico be part of the expansion of a league that has remained at 30 teams since the 2004-2005 season. Furthermore, it is public knowledge that Commissioner Adam Silver has always supported the idea of the NBA establishing itself permanently in Mexican territory.

The NBA, which has historically added two franchises in each expansion process, originally had its sights set on Las Vegas and Seattle—with the anticipated return of the historic SuperSonics. However, this latter option may have suffered a slight setback after it emerged that the financial offers submitted by its investment group were not sufficiently attractive to the league’s interests.

1967 (San Diego Rockets and Seattle SuperSonics)

1968 (Milwaukee Bucks and Phoenix Suns)

1970 (Cleveland Cavaliers, Portland Trail Blazers and Buffalo Braves)

1976 (San Antonio Spurs, Denver Nuggets, Indiana Pacers and New York Nets)

1988 (Charlotte Hornets and Miami Heat)

1989 (Minnesota Timberwolves and Orlando Magic)

1995 (Toronto Raptors and Vancouver Grizzlies)

Although the tradition has always been to add franchises in pairs, Adam Silver himself specified that this in no way guarantees that the formula will be repeated this time. The commissioner made it clear that there would be no issue if the NBA decided to expand to an odd number, historically opening the door to a 31-team league.

Mexican businessmen already know that if they want to get the green light for their project, they will have to make an investment that could reach as much as $10 billion. Despite the exorbitant figure, analysts remain cautious; they warn that it could all be a strategy by PJT Partners to pressure Seattle investors and force them to raise their initial economic proposal.

What is already a fact is that the two new franchises would join the Western Conference, which would force one of the teams that currently belongs to that division to move to the Eastern Conference.

articles.title: ‘Cleaning up that Stench’: Dillon Brooks joins feud, takes brutal jab at Kevin Durant
articles.standfirst: The Phoenix forward delivered a pointed Instagram message after Durant clashed publicly with Suns owner Mat Ishbia
articles.summary: The Phoenix forward delivered a pointed Instagram message after Durant clashed publicly with Suns owner Mat Ishbia
articles.body:
The tension surrounding Kevin Durant 's departure from the Phoenix Suns has escalated beyond a dispute with team ownership, with Dillon Brooks seizing the opportunity to deliver a cutting insult aimed at his former trade counterpart.

Durant 's relationship with Suns owner Mat Ishbia came under renewed scrutiny after the billionaire businessman acknowledged that acquiring the superstar in 2023 had been a mistake.

The comments prompted an angry response from Durant , now playing for the Houston Rockets , before Brooks joined the exchange with an Instagram post that appeared to question the impact the former MVP had on Phoenix's locker room.

Sharing a photograph of himself in a Suns uniform, Brooks wrote: "Thanks Matt for cleaning up that stench in the locker room before I came #culture."

The message, accompanied by 50 Cent 's Back Down, made clear that the forward was not interested in staying out of the controversy.

Durant response to Suns owner sparks confrontation

The latest dispute began when Ishbia reflected on Phoenix's unsuccessful attempt to build a championship contender following Durant 's arrival from the Brooklyn Nets .

Although Durant continued producing at an elite level, the Suns failed to achieve the postseason success expected from their expensive roster.

Durant subsequently challenged Ishbia 's assessment on X, arguing that his individual performances had remained strong throughout his time with the franchise.

"#blameKD even though KD stayed on top of his game at 36 and got u back this 'culture' you love so much," Durant wrote.

He then made a remark seemingly directed at Brooks , referencing the Suns forward's DUI arrest earlier this year.

"Aye, Matthew acts like I got arrested for a DUI or sumn. Back to threads," Durant added.

Brooks responded with his Instagram message, reviving an antagonistic relationship that has produced several confrontations on the court.

Dillon Brooks and Kevin Durant have history

Brooks was part of the blockbuster trade that sent Durant to Houston in 2025, with Jalen Green and draft assets also heading to Phoenix.

Since then, the two players have continued exchanging words during games, including a particularly heated meeting last season.

However, Durant previously insisted that Brooks' confrontational approach had little influence on his own performances.

"He don't get that type of credit with me," Durant said after one encounter. "Maybe some other guys that may turn up cause he talk to them, but he's not that important, especially with me to get me going."

Despite dismissing the significance of Brooks ' comments, Durant acknowledged the forward's competitive approach.

"I respect Dillon. I respect what he brings to the game. I think that gets him going more than me," he added.

Suns and Rockets rivalry set for another chapter

Brooks ' latest remarks have heightened anticipation surrounding the upcoming meetings between Phoenix and Houston.

The teams are scheduled to face each other on November 7 in Phoenix before meeting again in Houston on November 25.

Their final regular-season encounter is set for February 5, providing another opportunity for the rivalry to continue on the court.

Durant hasn't publicly responded to Brooks ' latest Instagram post, leaving the Suns forward with the final word in their most recent exchange.

With tensions involving the players and Phoenix ownership now spilling into public view, their first meeting of the season carries added significance beyond the result.

articles.summary: The scare comes just days before the NBA season begins and reignites concerns about the knee that hampered the guard late last season.
articles.body:
On Sunday, October 18, the Golden State Warriors opened the doors of San Francisco’s Chase Center for their traditional open practice , giving fans a preview of what to expect as the 2026-27 NBA season approaches. However, what was supposed to be an exciting afternoon for supporters took a concerning turn when Stephen Curry left practice and headed to the locker room without returning to the court .

What happened to Stephen Curry during practice?

Curry was involved in a play along the sideline against guard De’Anthony Melton when he appeared to feel discomfort after making a move on the perimeter. The point guard showed his frustration by slamming the ball to the floor as the action stopped and his teammates approached after noticing he was uncomfortable.

Shortly afterward, Curry left the court limping and did not return to practice .

Should Warriors fans be worried?

For now, it is too early to draw conclusions about what happened to Stephen Curry, as the Warriors have not disclosed what caused his discomfort or whether he has suffered a new injury. However, his condition is worth monitoring, as it involves the same knee that kept him sidelined for 27 games last season .

articles.title: Natalia Bryant stuns in her debut at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show in front of her mother, Vanessa
articles.standfirst: The 23-year-old made her appearance in Culver City, California
articles.summary: The 23-year-old made her appearance in Culver City, California
articles.body:
N atalia Bryant made her debut at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on Sunday, October 18, stepping onto the runway in Culver City, California , for a milestone in her developing modeling career. The 23-year-old is the daughter of NBA legend Kobe Bryant and Vanessa Bryant and wore a Victoria's Secret Pink outfit featuring a black bra with leopard-print lettering, a pink shrug and blue jeans decorated with colorful gemstones.

A silver belt with dangling dog-themed charms, a mirrorball handbag and strappy metallic heels completed the look whilst large silver heart-shaped earrings and a headband featuring a pink bow added further detail to the ensemble. Giving the young model a distinctive appearance at one of fashion's most recognizable annual events, Bryant expressed her excitement about finally participating in an event she had followed since childhood. “It feels amazing! I can’t wait,” Natalia told Page Six. “I used to watch the show every year — since I was a little girl. I had the shows on repeat, really trying to get into that mindset. And it’s crazy, because now I’m in the room with some of the OGs. Angels are among us!” The 2026 event featured performances from Tate McRae , Megan Thee Stallion , KATSEYE and Megan Moroney . However, the show generated controversy before the show began. Dutch model Romee Strijd , a former Victoria's Secret Angel , revealed on TikTok that she would not participate this year, prompting criticism from fans who questioned the decision to exclude the 31-year-old from the event.

Bryant family prepares to mark seven years since Kobe's death

Kobe spent 20 seasons with the Los Angeles Lakers , establishing himself as one of the greatest players in NBA history as the shooting guard won five championships, earned 18 All-Star selections and received the league's Most Valuable Player award in 2008. Nicknamed the Black Mamba for his fearsome mentality on the court, he also claimed two Olympic gold medals with the United States men's basketball team in 2008 and 2012 in Beijing and London respectively. Bryant entered the NBA directly from high school in 1996, joining the Lakers after being selected by the Charlotte Hornets with the 13th overall pick and developed into a franchise icon, forming a dominant partnership with Shaquille O'Neal that delivered three consecutive championships from 2000 to 2002. Bryant later led Los Angeles to further titles in 2009 and 2010, reinforcing his reputation as an elite competitor before he retired in 2016 as the Lakers ' all-time leading scorer and fourth on the NBA 's career regular-season scoring list at the time. His life was cut short on January 26, 2020, when a helicopter crashed in Calabasas, California , killing all nine people aboard, including Bryant and his 13-year-old daughter, Gianna . They were traveling to a youth basketball tournament and the tragedy shocked the sporting world and prompted an outpouring of grief from athletes, celebrities and fans whilst the Lakers honored Bryant following his death. Later, a public memorial at Staples Center brought together family members, former teammates and prominent figures from basketball.

articles.title: The curse of Ben Simmons: he tears his Achilles just when he was about to play again after a year and a half
articles.standfirst: The Australian Kings player will miss the season that is about to begin
articles.summary: The Australian Kings player will miss the season that is about to begin
articles.body:
The reputation of being a cursed player continues to haunt Ben Simmons . He has not played a game since April 13, 2025. He was about to do so. And now that he was seeing the light at the end of the tunnel, there is a setback on the way out: he has torn the Achilles tendon in his right leg. He will undergo surgery and, almost certainly, will miss the entire season that is about to begin.

In previous summers, social media used to fill up with videos of Simmons working on his shot, the one that has tormented him throughout his entire NBA career: a 13.9% success rate, going just 5/36 in 383 games. This time, without needing to show his poor shooting mechanics, he seemed ready for a return after overcoming his physical problems.

At 30 years old, the Kings had made room for him on their roster and he had made a very good impression in training camp. Also in the two preseason games played, in which he averaged 10.5 points in 17.5 minutes. He will not make his regular-season debut. A devastating injury during a five-on-five practice is a new blow for the Australian player.

"I have already faced challenges that tested me mentally, physically, and emotionally, and I have found a way to overcome them all. This injury is just another chapter in my journey, not the end of my story," Simmons explained in a statement after the injury became known. "It is never easy to be away from the sport I love, especially after everything it took for me to get back here, but if there is one thing I have learned, it is that adversity does not define you. What defines you is how you respond to it," the player concluded.

The No.1 pick in the 2016 draft

Simmons, the No. 1 pick in the 2016 draft selected by the Sixers , already missed his first NBA season due to a foot injury. After the 2017-18 season, he was named Rookie of the Year after averaging 15.8 points, 8.1 rebounds, 8.2 assists, and 1.7 steals. While in Philadelphia, he made the All-Star team three times and was included twice in the NBA All-Defensive First Team.

His relationship with the Sixers deteriorated to the extreme after the 2021 playoffs. The team lost in the Eastern Conference semifinals and Simmons was marked by several plays in which he passed up shots. Coach Doc Rivers and star Joel Embiid leveled criticism at him. The following season, Simmons claimed mental health issues and stayed away from practices. The franchise fined him numerous times and he was suspended in October 2021.

He missed the entire 21-22 season because of that rebellion and back problems. He ended up being traded to the Nets, where his situation did not improve much. Physical problems kept following him. Since then, his most games in a single campaign are the 51 he played in 24-25 between the Brooklyn franchise and the Clippers , where he was sent. His last game was in April of last year. He was about to return to the court and goes down again. Simmons is cursed.
